subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or repair the open fork cleanup PR as the fix path, replace it with a fresh narrow PR, or reject the Google Chat NO_REPLY placeholder cleanup?
rationale: Current main still has the source-level bug, but the issue already has an open closing PR from a fork, so ClawSweeper should not queue duplicate implementation work without a human path choice.

options.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR

options.title: Reject the cleanup
options.body: Close the fork PR and this issue only if maintainers decide the placeholder behavior is acceptable or no longer supported.
